supported_workflows: Clinical practice guideline retrieval and summarisation
supported_questions: What is the recommended use of PET/CT in head and neck cancer staging?
Should multigene profiling assays guide systemic therapy in early-stage breast cancer?
When is multiparametric MRI reasonable for pre-treatment local staging of prostate cancer?

overlap_with.nature: Both are medical QA resources, but clinical_guidelines contains full CPG articles while pubmedqa_eval contains yes/no/maybe QA over PubMed abstracts

weak_content: Sample file is only 17 records; the full corpus referenced in the README is not present
A substantial portion of the original corpus comes from WikiDoc, which is crowdsourced and less rigorously peer-reviewed than society guidelines
Guidelines are current as of August 2023; clinical recommendations may be outdated
primary_recommendation: Primary source for clinical guideline RAG when the full corpus is available. Treat the present sample as a preview; for medical QA benchmarking, use medical_pubmedqa_eval.
